extracted_decision.summary: Open a new docs task, update and clean the project docs against code plus the README, then auto-approve and handle it end to end on autopilot.
extracted_decision.rationale: Direct manager order grants docs-only autopilot authority with no separate plan-approval pause.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: No manager pauses; quality rests on the plan, markdown lint, grep proofs, bridge QA, and bridge review gates.
